Nothing shipped on the HUD this run. His answer to the four HUD questions in `questions.md` (line 3) is still missing.

The critic has held the HUD at 2 of 5 on every earlier run for the same reasons. Each fix would reverse one of his rulings, so I did not make them unasked:
- **Ammo hero:** one 56px ammo figure, where the source is 34px (his v23.94).
- **Currency row:** one top-right row, "Credits 900 · XP 0", dropping the stash/bag line (his `cw-stashbag`).
- **"$" on the bag line and scoreboard:** that is credits value, so it needs his word before it becomes SP.
- **Contracts list:** a cap of 3, when he said "ALL of them".

I added one line to `tools/handoff/console/notes/b-30-ui-hud.md` and did not repeat the audit. If he says yes to any of the four, it ships as its own mk script.

TASK PARTIAL: waiting on his answers to the four HUD points in questions.md (ammo hero size, currency row, "$" vs SP, contracts count). The critic cannot reach 4 on screens 19-24, 33, 34, 36, 37, 48, 50, 51, 61 and 78 without them.
